title: The fixed optimum includes repeated and nonorthogonal rows only in the proved noise range
statement: For F=U^TV/sqrt(m), independent standard Gaussian blocks, unit rows and independent N(0, s) noise, first read Y=U+eta then one read Z=(Y/||Y||)^TV+xi. With alpha=1/(1+s), predict alpha^2||Y||Z/sqrt(m); achieved risk1-alpha^2. For0 < s <= 1, r <= 2m, EVERY fixed unit-row design including repeats, nonorthogonal/mixed directions and arbitrary estimators has optimum risk1-r/[2m(1+s)^2]. At m=128, s=.01,129 adaptive reads give.0197039506 versus optimal fixed 129-read risk.5060226939;256 fixed reads match. At s=2, m=1, repeated direction gain 1/8 beats orthogonal gain 1/9, so the optimum formula cannot extend unchanged. General QAQ=0 noisy compression achieves full orthonormal noisy risk2(1-alpha^2)||A||F^2+(1-alpha)||b||^2, not all noisy adaptive optimality. Moment-only achieved-MSE robustness needs independent centered isotropic blocks/calibrated noise; Gaussianity remains essential to Bayes/fixed-optimal claims. Precision errors must be chosen from first transcript/private randomness before V/last noise.

requires: Known real symmetric A, b, c and X~N(0, I), or an actually acquired whitening transform with its own costs. Exact predictable scalar linear functionals, independent policy seed and almost-sure return. Dense measurement access must physically be supplied.
For noisy fixed benchmark: independent standard Gaussian U, V, unit measurement rows and independent equal-variance Gaussian readout s; exact optimal-fixed theorem only0 < s <= 1, r <= 2m.

Same law and measurement-policy class for model transfer; actual supplied/earned L2 error, calibration and implementation certificates. Finite interpolation agreement does not identify a quadratic promise.
